newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vodafone has security over Digicall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vodafone has security over Digicall.

text.p: Mobile telecommuniciations reseller Digicall Ltd said on Thursday that the Vodafone Group now had security over all of Digicall's assets.

"Digicall Group Ltd and its wholly-owned subsidiaries have today entered into documentation providing security to the Vodafone Group in respect of its guarantee of Digicall's A$15 million facility with National Australia Bank," Digicall said.

"The security now extends to all the assets, moneys and undertakings of the Digicall Group and its wholly-owned subsidiaries and secures all Digicall Group's indebtedness to the Vodafone group," it said.

The provision of this security would allow Digicall to issue drawdown notices which would be countersigned by Vodafone and allow Digicall to drawdown the balance of the A$15 million facility, it said.
Late last month Digicall said it was in funding talks with Vodafone after a write off of expenses linked to uneconomic accounts. Digicall's shares slumped after that announcement.
Digicall's shares closed down two cents at 14.5 cents on Wednesday.
